tail: The phone's screen always stays turned toward the person: the camera never sees it, only its acid lime light on the face and hands, breathing softly. Realistic, cinematic, 35mm, subtle film grain, natural human movement, palette of black, deep olive and acid lime neon #CCFF00 (a yellow-green, never pure yellow or orange). No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no numbers. Audio: no voice, no speech, no narration, no music with lyrics.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the tram sways gently and city lights slide past the window. She looks down at her phone, then slowly lifts her eyes straight into the camera and holds the gaze without blinking. Slow handheld push-in.
clips.sound: a low bass hit on the first frame, the rumble of the tram, a soft neon buzz.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: rain falls through the light, cars pass behind him in long streaks. He stands still in the crossing, looking at his phone, then raises his eyes into the camera and holds them there. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: rain on the asphalt, a car passing close, a deep sub pulse.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the city lights behind the glass flicker on one by one. She looks at her phone, then turns her eyes from the phone to the camera and holds the gaze, calm, not blinking. Slow push-in toward her eyes.
clips.sound: the distant hum of the city, one soft click.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: steam rises from the kettle. He scrolls with his thumb, eyes sharp and awake, then glances up into the camera for a moment. Slight handheld drift.
clips.sound: a kettle starting to hiss, a low electric hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: a train rushes past behind her, its windows strobing light across her. She keeps watching her phone and does not flinch; as the train is gone she looks up into the camera. Static camera.
clips.sound: the whoosh of a passing train, then sudden silence.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: city lights slide over the car window and across his face. He looks at his phone with a half smile, then lifts his eyes into the camera and holds them. Gentle car motion.
clips.sound: a car engine at night, the tick of an indicator.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: he taps his phone once with his thumb, the light on his face brightens, a small smile, then he looks up into the camera. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: a soft tap, then a warm electronic chime.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: she walks toward the camera, glances at her phone one last time, slips it into her coat pocket and walks on; the lime light fades from her face and the street lights take over. Tracking shot backwards.
clips.sound: footsteps on wet pavement, a soft fading hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: a washing machine drum turns behind her. She looks at her phone, then looks up into the camera. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: the hum and rhythm of washing machines.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: street lights pass over the bus window and over his face. He looks at his phone, then looks up into the camera. The bus sways.
clips.sound: a bus engine, the rattle of a window.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: wind moves his hair and jacket. He looks at his phone, then looks up into the camera. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: wind on a rooftop, the city far below.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: rain drops run down the windscreen, blurred lights shimmer. She looks at her phone, then looks up into the camera. Static camera.
clips.sound: rain on the roof of a car.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: her breath shows in the cold morning air, a few leaves move. She looks at her phone, calm and patient. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: birds, far traffic, a quiet breath.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the city lights come on outside the window. She looks at her phone, the lime glow on her face growing a little stronger, a slight nod. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: office room tone, a low slow pulse.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the intense lime light breathes on her face. She lifts her eyes from the phone straight into the camera and holds the gaze, never blinking. Slow push-in toward her eyes.
clips.sound: a deep bass hit on the first frame, then the steady buzz of neon.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the pupil contracts sharply as the lime reflection on the eye flickers brighter, the eye stays wide open and never blinks, not once; a very slow push-in toward the pupil.
clips.sound: a hard electric zap and a deep bass hit on the very first frame, then a close, low neon buzz.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the camera slowly pulls back and rises, revealing more and more windows, and in window after window another lime glow switches on, people looking down at their phones; nobody looks away.
clips.sound: a wide night city ambience, distant traffic, a low rising hum that swells as the windows light up.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the crowd rushes past him on both sides in fast motion blur. He alone stays completely still, eyes on his phone, then slowly lifts his eyes straight into the camera and holds the gaze without blinking while everyone keeps rushing. Static camera.
clips.sound: a deep bass hit on the first frame, the roar of a crowded station, hurried footsteps, a muffled departure chime.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the escalator carries her down, people hurry past her in a blur. She stays still, then lifts her eyes to the camera and holds them there, calm. The camera travels down with her.
clips.sound: the mechanical hum of an escalator, echoing footsteps, a train arriving deep below.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: traffic streams below in long light trails, wind moves his jacket. He stands still looking at his phone, then raises his eyes into the camera and holds the gaze. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: the wide rush of highway traffic, wind, a low sub pulse.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the elevator shudders slightly and a last emergency light flickers out. In the dark only the lime light on her face remains; she lifts her eyes into the camera, calm, not blinking. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: a heavy electric power-down thud on the first frame, a metal creak, then near silence and a soft neon buzz.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the lime light breathes on his face in the black stairwell. He looks up from the phone into the camera and holds the gaze, unmoved. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: a distant alarm dying out, a drip of water echoing, a low hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the last fluorescent tube down the row flickers and dies. She keeps watching her phone, then lifts her eyes into the camera and holds them there. Static camera.
clips.sound: the buzz and snap of a dying fluorescent tube, then a deep empty garage ambience.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: heavy snow falls through the lime light. She looks at her phone, then lifts her eyes into the camera, snowflakes on her lashes, not blinking. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: the muffled hush of snowfall, a distant bus engine, a soft deep tone.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: fog drifts slowly across the bridge and through the lime glow. He looks at his phone, then raises his eyes straight into the camera and holds them. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: a distant foghorn, water under the bridge, a low sub drone.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: rain streams down the glass, a lightning flash lights the room for an instant. She does not flinch; she lifts her eyes from the phone into the camera and holds the gaze. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: heavy rain on glass, a rolling thunder crack on the flash, a low hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the lime light from the phone floods his face. He holds the phone at arm's length, looks at himself on the screen, tilts his head slightly and taps to take the photo; the light stays on; then he lowers his eyes into the camera with a faint, confident half smile. Slight handheld drift.
clips.sound: a soft camera shutter click, a low neon buzz, a deep bass hit on the click.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: steam rises from the coffee and the horizon slowly brightens. She looks at her phone, then lifts her eyes into the camera and holds them, awake and calm. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: early morning city ambience, birds far away, a soft rising tone.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the wind moves her hair and jacket, the city lights shimmer far below. She looks at her phone, then lifts her eyes straight into the camera and holds the gaze, calm, not blinking. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: wind on a rooftop, the distant hum of a city at night, a deep bass hit on the first frame.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: rain streaks slide down the window. She reads something on her phone, her eyebrows lift slightly, a small surprised smile appears, then she looks up into the camera. Static camera.
clips.sound: soft rain on the glass, the quiet hum of an empty cafe, a cup set down gently.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: he scrolls slowly with his thumb, the lime light shifting on his face, then he nods slightly to himself and raises his eyes into the camera. Slight handheld drift.
clips.sound: a quiet night kitchen, a fridge humming, a soft tap on glass.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the lime light flickers softly on his face as he reads. He does not blink; slowly he turns his eyes from the phone to the camera and holds the gaze, wide awake in the dark. Very slow push-in.
clips.sound: a silent bedroom at night, a clock far away, his slow breathing, a low hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the pupil slowly widens as the lime reflection on the eye flickers once, the eye stays wide open and never blinks, not once; a very slow push-in toward the pupil.
clips.sound: a close, very quiet room tone, almost silence, a faint low neon hum.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: steam rises from the moka pot, he sips his coffee, glances down at the phone on the counter and a small calm smile appears; then he looks up into the camera. Slight handheld drift.
clips.sound: a moka pot gurgling softly, a spoon against a mug, early morning quiet.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: he spins the wheel slowly in his hands, stops it, glances at his phone on the bench, then goes back to work, calm. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: the soft ticking of a bicycle wheel spinning, a tool set down on a metal bench, a quiet workshop.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: she pulls the chair in, lifts the laptop lid and the lime light rises on her face; she settles, calm and focused, and looks at the screen. Static camera.
clips.sound: a chair on a wooden floor, a laptop lid opening, a quiet apartment at night, faraway city.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: the camera slowly rises and glides past her shoulder toward the city; across the whole city, window after window and street after street switches on in acid lime neon, spreading like a wave to the horizon, until the city glows; she and the others stand still, watching. No flicker, no cuts.
clips.sound: wind on a high rooftop, a distant city waking up, a deep low hum that slowly rises.

clips.motion: From the very first frame there is movement: a soft wind moves his curls, the lime light of the city breathes on his face; he turns from the city and looks straight into the camera with a calm, confident half smile, never blinking. Slow push-in.
clips.sound: morning wind at an open window, a distant city, a low neon hum.
